pages.text: Recruits! I am Captain Aldric. The training grounds are full of dummy targets — good for honing your combat skills. I have two assignments if you're up for the challenge.
Excellent, recruit! Destroy 5 training dummies and report back to me. I'll have a reward waiting.
Well done, recruit! You've proven yourself on the training grounds. Here is your reward. Keep pushing forward — greater threats await.
You haven't completed the assignment yet. Keep at it, recruit — those dummies won't destroy themselves!
You already have an active assignment or have already completed it. Focus on what's in front of you, recruit.
Goblin Archers have been harassing travelers to the east. Eliminate 10 of them and the roads will be safer. Return when the task is done.
